notes.title: Patch 3.0.0
notes.content:
[h2]CONTENT[/h2]

[list]
[*] The Backrooms: Eternal Shadows are now available! (More Details below)
[*] Added a new Save Game System (More Details below)
[*] Added an Final Menu after you completed both Story Modes

[/list]

[list]
[*] Added the DLC Shop on Steam and Epic Games. Available for free.
[*] Added a new Button in the Story Mode Tab to let Players teleport to the new Story.
[/list]

[b]Note: To Play this Story Extension, you need to own the "Full Game" DLC that is also required for the Normal Story Mode.
Note 2: We recommend to complete the Normal Story mode first before playing the Story Extension.[/b]


[h2]SAVE GAME REWORK[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a New Save Game System
[*] Now Players can only select "New Game" or "Load Game". Players can no longer select on which Level they want to Spawn.
[*] Because the System is new, every Player needs to Play from the beginning again (or should. To Unlock the Final Menu they also need to complete the Normal Story Mode again after this Patch in order to unlock it)
[/list]


[h2]LEVEL CHANGES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Removed all Notes from the previous Levels because we dont need them anymore
[*] Replaced the Computer in Level "THE END" with a Keypad
[/list]


[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Changed the Movement Speed from Bacteria in Level 0
[*] Slightly Increased the Generator Repair Speed in the TERROR HOTEL
[/list]


[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an Issue that caused to not get the Easter Eggs Rewards when collecting them (THE GHOST, THE STONE)
[*] Fixed an Issue that caused to not get any Coins when completing Levels
[*] Fixed an Issue where players got an Fatal Crash
[*] Fixed an Issue that some Levels where unplayable
[*] Fixed an Issue that the Music Volume was not changing when changed in the Settings Menu
[/list]

notes.title: Version 3.0 - What to expect
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Its time for a new Dev Blog. This Time we will talk about everything thats coming with the next Patch. The Next Patch is going to be a big one. Version 3.0 will feature new Level Changes aswell as the DLC.
Lets talk about the DLC First.


[h2]BACKROOMS: ETERNAL SHADOWS - WHAT TO EXPECT[/h2]

Journey back into the Backrooms and try to find the Exit this Time. The DLC will feature new Levels, aswell as old ones that are making their way back. The DLC will wrap up the Backrooms Story for our Game. So before playing the DLC we are highly recommending Playing the Normal Story first. Also here is an Important Announcement: [b]The DLC: Backrooms Eternal Shadows will be available for Free![/b]
The Only thing you need to own is the "Full Game" DLC that is also required for the Normal Story Mode.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678707/80f74bb64222ff7eb519566730bad20214070089.png[/img]


[h2]LEVEL CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]THE END[/h3]

In Level The End we are changing one Thing that got reported to us serveral Times.
After this Patch, you no longer need to go to the Computer to put in the PIN. Now you need to go to the Keypad and enter the PIN there. This will fix several Bugs in this Level.


[h3]LEVEL 188[/h3]

Also here, we only removed one Thing from the Level to make it better.
After this Patch, you no longer need to "put" the Numbers to open the first Door.
The First Door is now Automatically open. For the Second Door you still need to find the Key.


[h3]OTHER LEVEL CHANGES[/h3]

We removed all Notes from the Levels as these are no longer required. Also the Notes where not compatible with Gamepad so we deceided to remove the Notes from our Game.



[h1]SAVE GAME CHANGES[/h1]

We got several reports that Players are getting teleported back to the Main Menu after hitting "Start Game". This only happens if you didnt set a Level from the Drop Down Menu. To make it easier for the Players to start and Load a Game we are introducing a new Save Game Function.
After this Patch you can Start a New Game that will override your current Save or you can Load the Game from the Save you already have and continue Playing.


This is everything we have for you Today.
We are happy to announce that this Patch including the DLC will release late March! Stay Tuned for more Infos!

notes.title: Level Reworks and Changes for the Next Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Welcome back to another Dev Blog.
Today we want to show you what will come to the Next Update.
The Next Update will focuse on 2 Level Reworks and some Level Changes.
Lets get started!


[h1]LEVEL REWORKS[/h1]

[h2]LEVEL 96[/h2]

In the current Version of Level 96 you have to find the "Save House" to Escape. However we wanted to change that. Thats not because the current Level 96 is too Easy, its also not balanced enough.
The New Level 96 will feature only 1 Escape Way. Find the Open House around the Level to Escape. Also to make it a little bit harder, we added a Day and Night System to this Level and also some better Hills.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678707/c79be08bcb08cce062aab2bcfec10a0a23c41bdd.png[/img]


[h2]ELECTRICAL STATION[/h2]

The current Version of the Electrical Station is ok, but the Design of the Level is not what where intended for the Backrooms. So the New Version of this Level will feature some new Looking Models and a new "Tunnel Network".
Also its a little bit clearer on how to Escape from this Level.
We also removed the PIN Puzzle from this Level.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678707/e15e17afe6c416c7d302e0bfc099bc7b831fef8a.png[/img]


[h2]NEW SOUNDTRACK[/h2]

With this Patch we also added a New Soundtrack to the Game. The Poolrooms are getting their own Music! So when the Update goes Online you will hear a new Music when playing the Poolrooms Level!
We cant wait to see what you think about it.



We also changed some smaller things on other Levels that will be revealed when we share the Patch Notes. This Patch will go Online in February. Stay Tuned!


Until next Time

notes.title: Transition from Free to Paid
notes.content:
Dear Community,

We want to express our sincere gratitude for the overwhelming support and enthusiasm you've shown for The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows. Your dedication has allowed us to create an experience that we are incredibly proud of. Today, we would like to share some important news regarding the future of the game.

After careful consideration and evaluation of various factors, we have decided to transition The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows from a free-to-play model to a paid one. To make this Transition possible we have added a New DLC called "Full Version". This means without the DLC you can only Play Level 0 and Level 1 and then you need to buy the DLC. If you bought the Game before we made it Free, you can contact us via Email with a proof of Purchase and you will get a Key for the DLC.

We understand that this shift may raise questions, and we want to provide you with a transparent explanation of the reasons behind this decision.

[h2]Quality Enhancement[/h2]
Moving to a paid model enables us to allocate additional resources to enhance the overall quality of the game. This includes investing in advanced graphics, improved gameplay mechanics, and an even more immersive experience. Your support will directly contribute to making "The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows" an even more polished and enjoyable game.

[h2]Ongoing Development and Support[/h2]
The transition to a paid model ensures a sustainable future for the game, allowing us to provide ongoing updates, bug fixes, and new content. This approach ensures a consistent and high-quality gaming experience, as we can dedicate more resources to addressing community feedback and evolving the game based on your input.

[h2]Professionalism and Commitment[/h2]
Requiring a payment for the game reflects our commitment to delivering a professional and dedicated gaming experience. This allows us to focus on continuous improvement, respond promptly to community needs, and maintain a level of excellence in all aspects of the game.

[h2]Long-Term Viability[/h2]
By transitioning to a paid model, we are securing the long-term viability of "The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows." This ensures that we can sustain the servers, support the game's infrastructure, and provide ongoing service to our community. Your contribution will directly support the growth and stability of the game.

We understand that this transition may be unexpected, and we want to assure you that it was not a decision made lightly. We value your support and hope that you will continue to be a part of the Backrooms community as we work together to make "The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows" an even more remarkable and enduring gaming experience.

Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to the continued journey through the mysterious realms of the Backrooms.

Sincerely,

Cyprus Games Development Team

notes.title: Roadmap 2024 & A Look into the DLC
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

As promised we will do a last Dev Post for this Year where we talk about our upcoming DLC and our Plans for The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows for 2024.

Before we start with this we want to thank every Player for supporting us over the Year.
Without you the Game wouldnt be there where it is now.
We have many Plans for 2024 so stay Tuned!


[h2]DLC STORY EXTENSION[/h2]

Like we mentioned in other Posts, in the Main Story you end up in the Backrooms again...but this Time something changed. While it looks like the Normal Level 0, some Exits have been moved and more Levels have been added.
Embark on a chilling new journey in the DLC extension for "Backrooms: Realm of Shadows." As the unsettling mysteries of the Backrooms continue to unravel, a dark force emerges from the depths, threatening to plunge the realm into eternal darkness. This Time you will find the Exit!


[previewyoutube=MY9UMeAMRU4;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678707/3840fdcff46c00f75b616b0e1bcbce8e5c1a66da.png[/img]

The Backrooms: Eternal Shadows will release in Spring 2024. Stay Tuned for more Informations!


[h2]2024 PLANS FOR THE GAME[/h2]

We have many more Plans beside the DLC for the Game. Here is a short list on what you can expect next Year:

[list]
[*] Console Release
[*] Level Reworks
[*] More Shop Items
[*] In-Game Events
[*] Localisation
[*] And much more...
[/list]

Lets see some Details:


[h1]CONSOLE RELEASE[/h1]

The Console Release is something very Important for us. We want that all Players on the World can enjoy the Game.
The Console Release is currently target for: Playstation 4 and 5, Xbox One and Series X|S and Nintendo Switch.
Right now we dont have an Deadline but it will happen sometime Next Year. We will get back once we have more Informations on that.


[h1]LEVEL REWORKS[/h1]

Some Levels in the Backrooms feels....well they feel weird.
Some Levels already got their Rework but we have more on the List.

Reworks:

[list]
[*] Electrical Station
[*] Motion
[/list]

There are also changes planed for other Levels.

Changes:

[list]
[*] Kittys House
[*] Lights Out
[*] Level FUN
[/list]


[h1]LOCALISATION[/h1]

We want to add more Languages to the Game so it can be more enjoyable for Players who dont speak English. Right now we dont have any Deadline or ETA on when this Feature will release, but it is on our List and we will get back with that once we have more Informations.


This is everything for this Dev Post.
We hope you are as much Hyped as we are.
Again, thanks to everyone for supporting us over the Year. 


Merry Christmas and Happy new Year everyone.

See you Next Year!

notes.title: Next Plans
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Welcome back to an Dev Blog. In Todays Dev Blog, we are going to discuss what next Plans we have for the Game. In an previous Post we said that there is not much Content Planed for the Game, but well our Minds have changed!


[h2]MAIN MENU + LOBBY CHANGE[/h2]

In the Patch after Halloween, we are changed how to Lobby for the Story Mode works. Also, we are going to change the Main Menu a little bit. The Lobby will be removed and the "Game Options" Widget where you can change everything like Starting Level or Difficulty will be added directly to the "Story Mode" Widget. This should make it easier for New Players to understand how to start the Story Mode. 

The Main Menu will be changed the following Way:
Everytime the Player will be spawned to the Main Menu, you will be prompted to click anywhere to continue. Once clicked, the Main Widget will appear as well as the Menu Background. With this Update, we are adding 2 new Menu Backgrounds with more to come!



[h2]ELECTRICAL STATION[/h2]

In the Electrical Station, there is one Part where you can fall off the Map and have to Respawn. Yep this Part is getting Removed with the Update after Halloween. We have seen quite a few Gameplays where players thought they have to do anything in there. So we have deceided to remove this Area so New Players will easily understand they have to go back.



[h2]LIGHTS OUT BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]

With this Patch, we are also going to change some things in the Level: Lights Out. First we want to lower the Monster Run Speed in this Level for all Difficultys. Also, the Monster will spawn somewhere else so that new Players can have a better experience facing this Level.



[h2]TAPE COLLECTED CHANGES[/h2]

Well the Only thing we are going to change/add in the Tape Collected Gamemode is a Tutorial Screen so new Players know what to do in this Gamemode. With this Update, we are also going to remove the Tooltips on the Bottom.



[h2]LOADING TIME IMPROVEMENT[/h2]

Also, with this Patch we are going to Improve the Loading Time it takes to load into the Start Level.
Players have reported this Issue several Times and with this Patch this Bug is finally fixed!
After this Patch, once the Loading Screen starts, it should only take around 5 seconds and you are loaded into the Level!


The Changes listed above will Release after Halloween. An exact Release Date will be announced soon.
Also here is something we are announcing Today that is coming in the near Future:


[h1]DLC STORY[/h1]

Today we are Happy to Announce that in the near Future an DLC will become Available where Players can continuing exploring the Backrooms. In the Main Story end you endup again in the Backrooms...But this Time something changed...Some new Levels are making their Way into the Game aswell as new Entities. Also some Old Levels are going to be back. Stay Tuned for more Infos!



This is everything we have for Today. We hope you are as exited as we are and we can´t wait to see what you think about these Changes.

Until next Time!

notes.title: NEXT PLANS
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Its been a while since you last heard from us. So today we want to give you an Status Update on what we are working on Next.


[h2]MOVEMENT IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

We heard you loud and clear and we did some Tests with the current Movement and it just feels a little bit different that the other Games. We are also aware of the Jumping Bug and looking down bug. 
We will revamp our Movement System in Version 2.0 so that moving feels better and that Jumping and looking down is working properly. We are also fixing the Camera Head Bobbing. We will share more Informations once we come closer to the Release Date of this Version.


[h2]MORE MAPS FOR THE TAPE COLLECTED GAMEMODE[/h2]

The Tape Collected Gamemode is unlockable in the In-Game Store.
Right now, this Gamemode only has 1 Map which is The Forest.
With Version 2.0 we want to add more Maps to this Gamemode so the Player can change between the Maps and not just Play on the same Map again, again and again.


[h2]MULTIPLAYER AND UPGRADE FEATURE[/h2]

If you already Unlocked the Tape Collected Gamemode, you may have seen that we are currently working on the Multiplayer and Upgrades Feature for this Gamemode. With Version 2.0 you can Play with your Friends our with Global Players from all over the World and collect all 8 Tapes before the Entities get you. Also, the Upgrades Feature is coming with Version 2.0. After the Update, you can Buy and Upgrade Perks aswell as Items. You can then select the Perks and Item in the Lobby. This Feature is in the Early Development Stage and may change over the Time. We will share more Informations once we come closer to the Release Date of this Version.


[h2]POOLROOMS IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

The Poolrooms....what an relaxing Place....Well after Version 2.0 you can still Relax in this Level, but you need to find an Lever and switch it and then run to the Exit before the Exit closes. Also, when activating the Lever, an Entity will appear. We will share more Informations about this Change once we come closer to the Release Date of this Version.


[h2]LEVEL 69 IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

Just staying in the Light by your car...And just move with your car until you reach the End.
BORING!
Yes we agree with you and we will change this Level with Version 2.0.
Right now, we cant share any Detailed Informations on what you have to do in this Level. So Stay Tuned for more Informations!


[h2]MORE SHOP ITEMS[/h2]

And last but not least, we will add more Shop Items with Version 2.0.
This should keep the Player ahead of collecting Coins and completing the Game to buy all the Things from the Shop. Also, you will be able to collect Coins by playing the Tape Collected Gamemode right after this Update. 


This is everything we have for you Today.
We hope you like these new Changes and Improvements and we cant wait to share more Details soon with you.


Until next Time!

notes.title: SUB LAYER LEVELS
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our new Dev Blog is now Available!
In Todays Dev Blog, we will be covering everything about the Topic: Sub Layer Levels.

Lets get started!



[h1]WHAT ARE SUB LAYER LEVELS?[/h1]

Sub-layers are locations that usually add more detail to an existing level. There are two types of sub-layers "sub-levels" and "rooms". Sub-levels are levels that are related to their parent level, but are still their own distinct level. Rooms are locations that are too small to be considered their own level. Usually, they are places in an existing level, but that is not always the case. 



[h1]HOW CAN WE REACH THESE LEVELS IN THE GAME?[/h1]

When the Game releases, there will be first only 2 Sub Layer Levels. And these 2 Levels will be in Level 0. The Red Room and the Icy Rooms. You can access these Levels by going a Secret Way. The Sub Layer Levels dont have an Exit to a New Level, they will only have an Exit to the Normal Level 0.



Also, by reaching thouse Sub Layer Levels, you will be briefly rewarded by an Achivement.

We will add more Sub Layer Levels later after your Feedback so we know how we can improve.



[h2]Take a Closer look at the 2 Sub Layer Levels[/h2]

notes.title: SHOP SYSTEM
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to the First Dev Blog!
In todays Dev Blog we are going to show you how our Shop System works.



[h1]THE SHOP SYSTEM[/h1]

In the Main Menu, a new Button will appear called "Store". When clicking on this Button, you will come to a New Level where you can Buy things with In-Game Currency.
The Shop Level is not a Widget, it is a Level where you can go around. Thats cool isnt it?

In the Shop Level, go to the Shop Merchant to access the Store. A Widget will appear that looks like this:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43678707/d8510351b4c82620f12fce2433906bda62ad70c9.png[/img]

Well of course the Black Color will be removed in the Game. But we dont want to tell you to much. So Stay tuned!



[h1]IN-GAME CURRENCY[/h1]

The In-Game Currency is a Basic System and is easy to collect. Every Level you finish in the Backrooms, we will award you some Coins. If you find Easter Eggs you even get more Points. Right now, points are easy to collect and we might change that in the Future. If we add more Stuff in the Shop we might also give you the Chance to Buy Coins with Real Money. Stay Tuned!


[h1]WHAT IS IN THE SHOP?[/h1]

When the Game Releases, there are only a few things in the Shop. We will expand this with Future Updates. With Version 1.0 you can buy a Gamemode in the Shop, 1 Feature, Easter Eggs and more.
As we said we will expand this and maybe some things will be added during the Development. So Stay Tuned!


This is all we can say Right now about the Shop System. We hope you will like it!

The Next Dev Blog will release on June 5th.

Until next Time!
